why: The presenter opens beside the board; four request cards appear in a stack, each stamped urgent.
Ticks run down the list in arrival order while a clock moves to Friday; the one important card is left unticked at the bottom.
The word urgent splits into two labels drawn apart: how soon, how much it matters; a balance tilts toward the deadline side.
Two questions written large on the board: Impact? and Effort?
The two questions become axes drawn on the board; the client reply card lands high on the left.
The other three cards land one by one on the same board: high right, low left, low right.
The board divides into four zones; the top left is named quick wins and the client reply gets a tick.
Top right named major projects; the budget report becomes one solid block in a calendar strip instead of scattered fragments.
Bottom left named fill-ins with a batch bracket; bottom right named thankless tasks, the deck card set aside with a later tag.
A reply note is drafted beside the board with an arrow to the budget report; two options are written under it: a date and a smaller version.

why: Continuity break across b05 and b06: card_reply in the top-left quadrant disappears at b06 arrive (35.20s) and stays missing throughout b06, leaving quadrant 1 completely empty before reappearing in b07.

data.fix: In scenes/b06.js, keep and render card_reply in the top-left quadrant so it remains visible while the remaining three cards are drawn.

why: Continuity break across b07 and b08: the matrix quadrant dividers (divider_v and divider_h) and the top-left quadrant content (card_reply, tick_reply, and zone_quick) vanish completely starting at b08 arrive (52.22s) and remain absent through b12.

data.fix: In scenes/b08.js, ensure divider_v, divider_h, card_reply, tick_reply, and zone_quick are kept and rendered from the previous beat rather than dropped.

why: Element overlap in top-left quadrant: at b07 develop (48.53s) and settled (51.32s), 'Do first' and the reply tick box collide and overlap directly beside the Client reply card.

data.fix: In scenes/b07.js, adjust the layout coordinates of move_quick and reply_tick_state so 'Do first' and the tick box sit clear of each other and of the card boundary.

why: Stray floating element: at b13 arrive (95.37s), an unlabelled small checkbox box sits detached to the left of the third blank card row before cards reorder.

data.fix: In scenes/b13.js, tie the checkbox entrance to the Client reply card row rather than revealing a detached box at arrival.

why: Reading floor violation: the gloss label 'work it takes' under 'Effort?' appears at 26.8s and is visible for only 0.61s before the beat transition at 27.41s.

data.fix: In scenes/b04.js, advance the reveal cue for 'work it takes' by 0.25s so it satisfies the reading floor before the beat ends.

why: Continuity break across b07 and b08: the Client reply task card in the top-left quadrant disappears at b08 arrive (52.22s) and remains missing through b12, leaving only the checkmark and 'Do first' label floating without their card.

data.fix: In scenes/b07.js and scenes/b08.js, keep card_reply visible in the top-left quadrant alongside its tick mark rather than exiting its outline and words, so the Client reply card stays on the matrix through b08-b12.

why: Spacing crowd in top-left quadrant at b07 settled (51.32s): the green checkmark box and 'Do first' label sit tightly compressed against the right edge of the Client reply card.

data.fix: In scenes/b07.js, adjust the x position of move_quick ('Do first') so there is comfortable spacing between the Client reply card, the checkmark box, and the label.

why: Action labels 'Batch' and 'Decline or park' are missing from the board at b09 develop and settled (and held beats b10 to b12) because m.travel translates them off screen.

data.fix: In scenes/b09.js, remove or adjust m.travel so that move_fill ('Batch') and move_thankless ('Decline or park') remain visible under their respective zone titles instead of translating off canvas.

why: In b12 develop (91.89s) and settled (94.07s), the 'New analysis by Friday' card disappears off screen to the right instead of moving into the Major projects quadrant, leaving the curved connector arrow originating from an empty space.
